Title: Add embeddings://search MCP resource (raw semantic search via Nomic)
Description: Expose the Nomic embedding index as a queryable MCP resource. Caller passes a query string and gets back semantically similar document chunks. Distinct from splitbrain_search_codebase tool — this is a raw semantic search endpoint that can be used against any indexed corpus. Requires background indexing (Phase 3). Backed by SQLite-vec store.
